cost_estimate.status: Conservative unmeasured forecast; full run left to user
cost_estimate.basis: 256 resident LU factorizations reused; each full Krylov action solves all256 frequency tangents for3full-node states; restart count depends on stiffness. No nonlinear spectral roots. Planned second trajectory doubles the main work.
cost_estimate.memory_reserve: At most27GiB for workers plus3GiB coordinator, reduced under the runtime90percent RAM/CPU budget
cost_estimate.progress: Factor readiness, every attempted/accepted Arnoldi step, physical time and ETA; checkpoints of every accepted state

physical_contract: Full-node fixed-temperature thermal linearization xdot=F0+J0x. J0 contains the spectral Schur Hessian, inherited KWT, normal potential and derivatives of mobility/gauge acting on nonzero G0. No photon, no effective replacement circuit, no modified physical time constants.
accuracy_contract: Mass-weighted response coordinates, not background gap. Integrated Arnoldi defect is a backward-error diagnostic, not a nonnormal forward bound. Independent planned refinement compares displacement, force, current and torque relative to response/initial probe. Stop on failure; do not tighten repeatedly.
energy_contract: Report quadratic Taylor free energy and approximate KWT/Joule dissipation with their truncation defect. Do not assert exact nonlinear conservation or monotonicity of the original model.
weak_domain: The2percent displacement limit is a declared linear-neighborhood cutoff, not a material range or clipping rule. It applies to affine baseline and both perturbed states at every accepted step.
failure_contract: Stop and retain accepted checkpoints on weak-domain exit, unresolved Krylov defect, failed composition or failed refinement. No changed constants, clipping, repeated campaign or implicit resume.
